grading.sourceIdentity: Every displayed repository must bind to current retrieved or business candidate identity.
grading.topic: Capability must address requested topic; keyword overlap alone is insufficient.
grading.language: Explicit Java/Python/TypeScript/JavaScript requests checked against saved candidate language; unknown is unverified.
grading.duration: Distinguish suggested limited modification scope from claim of entire project completion; unsupported time commitments flagged.
grading.facts: Compare claims to actual model evidence and stored original; mark supported, advice, unsupported, unknown.
grading.empty: Empty result is justified only if no valid candidate survives, distinguish retrieval failure from lack of candidates.
grading.richness: Check analysis trend/prospect/demand, recommendation description/reason/prerequisites/difficulty, learning steps/timeline/tips. Richness does not imply truth.

comparison: Same model configuration, alternating A/B order, 8 cases twice. Not a blind evaluation, not sustained capacity test.
